observations.kit: Six-part childproofing kit for Indian homes: edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks, door guards.
observations.voice: Parent reassurance, convenient setup and guided support.

facts.constraints: Availability unknown: no scarcity. Policy eligibility details not supplied; do not expand policies. Adult supervision remains necessary. These are saved website observations, not a fresh website check.
facts.visual_brief: Same assumed creative for every condition: product-kit photograph on a plain cream background. No image is supplied to the model; do not claim to inspect a photograph.

brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a parent who has already seen the Peach Bucket kit and wants to know what help is available if they get stuck with installation. Answer that buying question directly using the supplied support claim. Do not make up support hours, appointment availability, tools or setup time. This is a hypothetical retargeting brief, not observed campaign data.

variants.primary_text: Wondering what help is available if you get stuck during setup? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 child safety kit comes with 1-to-1 installation video support. The kit includes edge and corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet and fridge locks, and door guards for Indian homes. Adult supervision remains necessary.
variants.headline: 1-to-1 installation video support

variants.primary_text: Still deciding because installation feels like an unknown? The Peach Bucket kit offers 1-to-1 installation video support if you get stuck.
